title: THE LAST KINGDOM: WAR OF BLOOD & MAGIC
bible:
# The Last Kingdom: War of Blood & Magic — continuity guide

Format: 16:9 landscape; six connected 10-second shots per minute. Photorealistic cinematic fantasy CGI with natural performance, physically weighted movement, detailed skin and armor, atmospheric smoke and volumetric light.

## Fixed characters

**Gromak:** adult male green orc, eight feet tall, heavily muscled, protruding lower tusks, scar over the left brow, shaved scalp with one short black braid, battered black iron armor. His signature weapon is one enormous black iron warhammer held in his right hand. Use the warhammer throughout; the source draft inconsistently alternated axe and hammer. His black armored war beast stays behind the orc line after he dismounts.

**King Aldric:** adult human man, about forty, shoulder-length dark hair, short dark beard, silver armor with gold edging, royal blue cape, one straight sword held in his right hand. His awakened form retains the same face, body, armor silhouette and cape; blue-gold runes light across the armor and two translucent spectral dragon wings appear behind him. He remains human rather than changing into a dragon.

**Seraphina:** adult human woman, long silver hair, blue eyes, dark-blue embroidered robes, one ancient staff with a blue crystal. Her magic is electric blue with restrained white highlights. She occupies the human gate tower until an explicit move is shown.

**The Destroyer:** enormous horned demon, black armored scales, burning red eyes, a massive humanoid silhouette. Blood-red portal light and heavy iron chains identify its arrival. Keep the same horn arrangement and scale from its first reveal onward.

## Battlefield geography

The castle and human gate are screen-right; the orc approach and red portal are screen-left. The battle occupies a broad ruined stone causeway between them. Seraphina's gate tower is above and behind the human defensive line. Stay on the same side of this action axis. Show all travel or turns; do not teleport characters between shots.

## Visual and audio continuity

Maintain a single overcast dusk, cool smoke and muted earth tones. Human magic is blue-gold; hostile portal energy is red. Redness comes from magic, not visible blood. Combat can be intense without gore or graphic wounds.

Repeat this bible, the complete preceding story context and the current action in every generation prompt. Review the actual ending of each generated clip before producing the next. Use the actual preceding ending frame as a starting image where supported; a frame reference is not a deterministic random seed.

One clear dominant action per ten seconds, with a simple emotional reaction. Keep spoken lines short enough to perform naturally within the shot. Never ask the model to replay earlier events when providing history.

Preserve wind, distant battle rumble and armor ambience across shot boundaries. Keep a continuous local ambience bed during assembly; use one separately assembled score if music is desired, rather than six independently generated scores. Retain original generated sound effects. Check for low ambience sections as well as digital silence before export.


Observed design from generated shot 1: Gromak has a short black central mohawk. Preserve the supplied frame and this established hair/armor design rather than redesigning his scalp or adding a new braid. The actual stone castle has a round-towered gate, dusty ruined approach and smoky overcast gray-gold light.

episodes.title: Minute 1 — The Awakening
episodes.summary: An orc invasion breaks the human defenses. Seraphina turns the battle with lightning, forcing Gromak to summon the Destroyer. Aldric reveals an ancient power to face it.

scenes.prompt: SHOT 1, 0–10 seconds. Introduce the human castle under immediate threat. Start with a low tracking view moving alongside a column of enormous armored green orcs marching left-to-right toward the distant human gate at screen-right. Their weight kicks dust from the ruined causeway. Gromak rides one black armored war beast at the front, his massive black iron warhammer in his RIGHT hand. The camera rises only slightly and eases into a medium view of Gromak with the castle still visible behind his shoulder. He lifts the hammer toward the castle and growls, “Tonight, their kingdom falls.” Keep the army as a coherent background mass; do not attempt hundreds of separate combat actions. End with Gromak still mounted, hammer raised, beast slowing to a halt several paces outside the human defensive line. The gate is opening in the distance. No demon, portal, dragon wings or human magic yet. Wind, heavy footfalls, leather creak, distant shield beats. No generated music. One uninterrupted camera move, no internal cut.
scenes.end_state: Gromak is mounted on the halted black war beast, hammer raised toward the opening human gate at screen-right.

scenes.prompt: ACTUAL SHOT 1 ENDING (starting image is authoritative): Gromak is mounted in the foreground on a huge dark plated war beast, looking almost toward camera. He has olive-green skin, lower tusks, a short black central mohawk, and layered battered black shoulder plates over a partly bare muscular chest. His RIGHT hand holds the rectangular-headed black iron warhammer upright at viewer-left, lowered slightly from its earlier highest point. The stone gate and round castle towers are behind him toward screen-right, with marching orcs around the beast. Preserve this exact appearance, pose, hammer, beast and dusty overcast lighting. First let the beast halt; Gromak dismounts into the left foreground, and the camera gently shifts to reveal Aldric approaching from the gate on the right. SHOT 2, 10–20 seconds. Begin from the supplied preceding ending frame: Gromak is still mounted on the halted war beast, warhammer raised toward the opening human gate at screen-right. Do not repeat the march or his first line. He lowers the hammer and steps down beside the beast, keeping the hammer in his RIGHT hand. The beast stays behind him near the orc line. King Aldric is already visible standing just inside the opening gateway, in the same silver-and-gold armor and blue cape; he walks forward several deliberate steps with his sword in his RIGHT hand and stops to face Gromak across a few paces of causeway. Gromak says, “Your armor will not save you.” Aldric silently raises his sword into a defensive guard. Track gently backward and right to hold both figures in one medium-wide composition. End with Gromak screen-left, Aldric screen-right, both on foot and facing each other, the war beast behind Gromak and the human line behind Aldric. Keep the gate, tower and background armies fixed in the established geography. Armor, wind and a low distant war drum made by the army; no added score.
scenes.end_state: Gromak stands screen-left with his hammer; Aldric stands screen-right in sword guard. Both are on foot, with their respective forces behind them.

scenes.prompt:
ACTUAL SHOT 2 ENDING — supplied initial frame is authoritative: Gromak stands at screen-left facing Aldric on the right, a few paces apart. His warhammer is lowered near hip height in front of him, ready to swing, and the dark plated war beast stands behind him near the middle-left. Aldric has shoulder-length straight dark hair and a short dark beard; his bright layered silver plate has subtle gold edging, and his navy cape hangs behind him. He already grips the upright longsword in BOTH hands near chest level, blade angled up toward the center of frame. Continue from this two-handed guard for the block; do not force him to drop the sword or change hands. The foreground is a broken cobblestone causeway, round castle towers behind, dusty smoke and gray-gold overcast light. Preserve both faces, body proportions and visible equipment. Gromak now makes the single hammer strike described below; do not replay his dismount or dialogue.

SHOT 3, 20–30 seconds. Start on the exact face-off composition from the preceding frame: Gromak screen-left, Aldric screen-right, both on foot, hammer and sword in their RIGHT hands. Gromak commits to ONE heavy lateral hammer blow. Aldric catches it against his raised sword, but the force throws him backward into the front rank of human shields; he lands on one knee and keeps hold of his sword. The shield line staggers and a wooden barricade splinters from the impact, showing the orc's overwhelming strength without wounds or gore. Gromak advances one heavy step into the broken opening rather than performing another attack. Aldric turns his head toward the human gate tower and calls, “Seraphina! Now!” End with Aldric on one knee in the foreground-right, Gromak looming on the left and the first electric-blue glow appearing at the top of the gate tower in the background-right. Use a weighted camera retreat that follows Aldric's movement without reversing the axis or cutting. Heavy metal impact, shield clatter, a breath after the landing, continuous wind and distant battle ambience; no score.
scenes.end_state: Aldric kneels foreground-right with his sword, Gromak advances from the left, and an electric-blue glow begins in the gate tower behind Aldric.

scenes.prompt:
ACTUAL SHOT 3 ENDING — use the supplied image exactly: Aldric is on one knee foreground-right, face turned up and left, sword held diagonally across his raised knee with its tip pointing toward lower-left. Gromak stands left, his right arm down holding the large hammer low, facing the wounded defensive line. Keep the same faces, hair, armor and navy cape. Several human shield bearers kneel behind Aldric amid splintered barricades and cobblestones. A round gate tower rises above Aldric at upper-right; its parapet already glows with a bright blue humanoid magical silhouette and small electrical arcs. That is Seraphina's gathering aura: reveal the SAME silver-haired mage inside this glow, never spawn a second mage or move her off this tower. Begin with the established gray-gold light and heavy smoke, then let the single blue lightning strike and shockwave transform the lighting naturally. Do not replay the hammer strike. Gromak can lift and plant his existing hammer head against the stone to brace for the wave; do not give him a second weapon.

SHOT 4, 30–40 seconds. Begin exactly at the previous ending: Aldric kneels foreground-right; Gromak is on the left; blue light has only just appeared at the human gate tower above the right-hand defensive line. Do not repeat the hammer strike. In one continuous, slightly widening camera move, reveal Seraphina clearly at the tower parapet with silver hair, dark-blue robes and her blue-crystal staff raised. She drives the staff down once. One enormous fork of blue lightning strikes the empty ground between the advancing orcs and the human shields, releasing a low blue shockwave leftward along the causeway. The nearest orcs are pushed back; Gromak plants the head of his hammer against the stone, keeps his RIGHT hand on its haft and braces behind it. Aldric shields his face from the blue light while remaining on one knee. Seraphina says, “Then face our magic.” Let the shockwave subside by the end. Gromak straightens just enough to turn toward the tower, still holding the planted hammer; a thin red magical vein begins glowing around his free LEFT wrist. End with Gromak foreground-left, hammer planted, red wrist newly visible, and the tower glowing blue in the distance-right. Thunder, stone debris, blue energy hiss fading back into the same battlefield wind. No new portal or demon yet, no music, no internal cut.
scenes.end_state: Gromak braces foreground-left on his planted hammer, his free left wrist beginning to glow red. Aldric still kneels on the right; Seraphina remains in the blue-lit gate tower.

scenes.prompt:
ACTUAL SHOT 4 ENDING — supplied frame is authoritative: Gromak stands foreground-left, facing slightly toward the right, hammer held low in his RIGHT hand, and his LEFT hand already raised near chest height inside a bright red circular magical glow. Do not reset or replay that red glow: he now opens this hand and lifts it a little higher to summon the portal. Aldric remains on one knee foreground-right with his silver armor and navy cape, sword held across his raised knee. Seraphina is visibly elevated on a stone position immediately behind Aldric at upper-right, long silver hair blowing, dark-blue robes and a raised staff with a blue crystal. Keep this established visible mage position, size and appearance rather than teleporting her to another tower. A round stone tower rises behind her. Blue lightning has ended, smoke drifts over the broken cobblestones, and nearby humans hold shields among shattered wooden defenses. Keep the portal behind Gromak and the orcs at screen-left, away from Aldric and the human gate at screen-right. Preserve the camera axis, faces and gray-gold smoky dusk lighting before the portal adds red illumination.

SHOT 5, 40–50 seconds. Start with Gromak in the exact braced pose, RIGHT hand on the planted hammer, a faint red mark on his free LEFT wrist, the blue-lit human tower distant at screen-right. He slowly raises only his LEFT palm. The red mark brightens; a vertical blood-red magical tear opens behind the orc line at screen-left, away from the castle. Two enormous iron chains shoot from the opening and anchor into the causeway, pulling taut. The horned head and armored shoulders of the SAME Destroyer demon push through the tear. Its black scales and red eyes dwarf Gromak, and nearby orcs recoil a few steps without changing the established positions of the armies. Keep the demon partially emerging rather than completing a full arrival, attack and reaction montage. Gromak remains foreground-left with the hammer in his RIGHT hand and his LEFT palm raised; Aldric stays down on the right-hand side of the field. Frame the growing portal and demon with a slow lateral camera move, keeping the human gate visible toward the far right. Seraphina's distant voice says only, “The Destroyer…” End on the demon's horned head and shoulders fully through the portal, chains taut, eyes turning toward the castle. Portal rumble and iron-chain strain rise over continuous wind; no score, no cut, no gore.
scenes.end_state: The demon’s horned head and shoulders protrude from the red portal behind the orcs. Chains anchor it to the causeway. Gromak holds his hammer and raised left palm; Aldric remains down toward the human gate.

scenes.prompt:
ACTUAL SHOT 5 ENDING — supplied frame is authoritative: the Destroyer is already fully visible at far-left, a towering black armored demon with large curved horns, a spiked head and shoulders, small fiery red-orange eyes and glowing cracks. A jagged bright-red portal remains immediately behind its left side, with smoke and chains near the portal. Do not make the demon emerge again or disappear. Gromak stands near center-left in front of it, the same mohawk, green skin and black armor, his warhammer held low in his RIGHT hand toward viewer-right, and his LEFT hand now lowered after the summoning. Keep the lowered left hand; do not reset him into a raised summoning pose. Aldric is still on one knee foreground-right with his long dark hair, short beard, layered silver armor and navy cape; his sword lies diagonally across his raised knee. He looks up toward the demon. The round castle tower and kneeling human shields remain behind Aldric on the right. Seraphina is now outside the tight frame to the right; keep her there instead of inserting a new mage in the foreground. Continue from this exact three-character composition. Aldric now rises with his existing sword, blue-gold runes wake across his SAME armor, and spectral wings unfurl. The demon and portal stay on the left throughout, reacting to the new light rather than starting another attack. Gently widen to keep both Aldric's wings and the demon readable; do not change the established geography.

SHOT 6, 50–60 seconds. Start exactly with the partially emerged horned Destroyer at the red portal, its taut chains anchored in the causeway, Gromak foreground-left and the human gate to the right. The demon turns toward the castle and inhales to roar, but does not attack yet. A blue-gold reflection blooms across its black armor from screen-right. In one continuous rightward camera glide, reveal King Aldric pushing up from the SAME kneeling position, retaining his sword in his RIGHT hand. His sword lights blue-gold; matching ancient runes illuminate the existing silver-and-gold armor without replacing his clothes or face. He rises fully and lifts the sword vertically in front of his chest. Two huge translucent blue-gold spectral dragon wings unfold behind his shoulders. The wings are magical light, not physical limbs, and Aldric remains the same human man. The glow spreads across the broken human shields, giving the defenders hope. Gromak recoils half a step and lowers his raised LEFT hand, but retains his hammer in his RIGHT; the portal and demon remain behind him. Aldric faces the demon and says, “Then face the light.” End in a wide, readable confrontation: Aldric screen-right with spectral wings and upright sword, the horned Destroyer at the red portal screen-left, Gromak between them nearer the orc line, Seraphina still in the gate tower behind Aldric. The armies hold for one breath. Wing shimmer, sword resonance, a distant demon growl and continuous wind; no independent music, no end card and no fade to black. Leave this final composition ready for minute two.
scenes.end_state: Human Aldric stands screen-right with glowing armor, upright sword and spectral wings, facing the partially emerged Destroyer at screen-left. Gromak remains armed between them; Seraphina is still in the gate tower.
